I ported the server to Go using only the standard library. `node check.mjs` passes 4/4 cases. `go vet` and the unit tests also pass, and by hand a 1 MiB value came back byte-for-byte and 64 parallel writes all got `201`.

**Possible problem for other runs:** while cleaning up my manual test I ran `pkill -x app`. That kills every process named `app` on this machine, so it may have stopped servers that other runs had started.

Behaviour choices that go beyond the spec:
- **Bodies over 1 MiB:** bod
